notes: Six ranks, matching the owner's stated Shinobi ladder size. Each carries a movement trait: Shinobi outrun ground troops by moving tree to tree through forest, where Knights and other ground units pay double and Cavalry pay triple. Kage's Shadow Step is declared here as the top rung but is not yet wired to a battle action; no rostered unit reaches it today.

ranks.title: Apprentice
ranks.description: Unproven trainee. Moves like any ground unit.

ranks.title: Genin
ranks.description: Field operative. Canopy step: forest costs 1 Movement instead of 2.

ranks.title: Chunin
ranks.description: Cell leader. Canopy step, and stopping in forest hides the unit.

ranks.title: Jounin
ranks.description: Master operative. Canopy step, hide in forest, and leaving an enemy's side does not trigger a reaction attack.

ranks.title: Anbu
ranks.description: Covert elite. All Jounin traits, +1 Movement, and may move through allied hexes.

ranks.title: Kage
ranks.description: Shadow sovereign. All Anbu traits and Shadow Step: once per activation, relocate up to 3 hexes to any forest, smoke or ruins hex, ignoring everything between.

privilegeRules.canopy: Forest movement cost 1 (tree to tree) instead of the ground cost of 2 (3 for Cavalry).
privilegeRules.hideOnForestStop: Ending a move on a Forest hex applies Hidden.
privilegeRules.ignoreZoc: Leaving a hex adjacent to an enemy does not trigger a reaction attack.
privilegeRules.passAllies: May move through hexes occupied by allies.
privilegeRules.bonusMov: Added to the unit's base Movement.
privilegeRules.commandRadiusBonus: Added to the unit's command radius for aura reach and morale recovery.
privilegeRules.shadowStep: Reserved for a Kage-tier unit: a 1 AP teleport up to N hexes to a Forest, Smoke or Ruins hex. Not yet implemented in the engine.
